purpose: Fail-closed READY signal for whether a named factory write may move a County Manifest cell. Canvas captions are not this pin.
trigger: WDLL items 3-6. Not a repo-wide hook.
failsWhen: exit 1 when ready:true lacks dest/join/servingHop/planRow, defect is non-null on a ready row, who-serves or city-limits is claimed as a Manifest rail, a vacuous empty phrase is used as a check, or P-25 / P-09 / roads COVER are ready:true
bypasses: anyone who does not run the script. Canvases live outside git.
readyRule: ready:true is forbidden unless dest, join, servingHop, and planRow are all non-empty AND defect is null. Serving hops already on a named revision may be ready:true only when they are not a new ingest.
